d: NIA Director General Rakesh Aggarwal has said the agency cannot charge US national Matthew Aaron Van Dyke under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) at this stage. The agency is examining whether the alleged militant training imparted by Van Dyke and six Ukrainian nationals to ethnic armed groups in Myanmar benefited Indian insurgent groups. Van Dyke was arrested for allegedly crossing into Myanmar illegally from India and is currently out on default bail. The NIA has already filed charges in connection with the illegal border crossings.
